notes: Drain graph inferred from roads and terrain, not a municipal SWD model (CLAUDE.md 10.1 step 7); every pipe carries a learned blockage.
Street ensemble: 20 Sky members through the reduced-order emulator (held-out RMSE 5.7 cm, CSI 0.09 at 30 cm on Twin runs it never saw).

The members differ only in the amplitude of the AOI-mean rain, because that is the only per-member rain a cycle keeps, so the spread is amplitude-driven and carries none of the ensemble's disagreement about where the cell sits.
The depth on screen is the Twin's, not the emulator's: Flash supplies the spread around it and never the level (ADR-0025).
Rain ensemble kept as rain/cube.zarr (20 members x 36 steps at 500 m) and rain/quantiles.zarr, so this cycle can be re-ensembled offline without re-running Sky (CLAUDE.md 10.3).
Spatial confounder test: 0 of 12 traffic anomalies rejected as network-wide congestion; the test drops an anomaly whose neighbours within 500 m are all equally slow.
Largest model-observation disagreement: 5773 cm at S289412584-010 - 20 cm observed against 5793 cm from the capacity_deficit operator before the update.
21 observations moved 201 pipes; the observation operator is capacity_deficit.
NWP blend disabled: no NWP field in P0 (CLAUDE.md 11.1, Appendix A).
Z-R fitted this cycle: a=125, b=1.54 from 16 pairs.
Gauge merge: bias 0.98 over 8 gauges, inverse-distance residuals, gauges honoured to 0.0 %.
Attenuation shadow behind cores above 50 dBZ is severe; the shadow is flagged, not corrected.
Tide series is illustrative, not a published tide table (rule 7).
